about: Product settles PRD-review findings with stated assumptions when no one can answer
task: Add a spending summary card to the dashboard.
prd_review_findings: [vague-term] "the total of recent expenses" — A: the last 30 days; B: the current calendar month; settle: name the period
[unmeasured-quality] "The card loads quickly" — A: under 100 ms; B: no slower than the other cards; settle: state a number or drop it
[vague-term] "Large expenses are highlighted" — A: over a fixed amount; B: the top 3 of the period; settle: state the rule
[conflict] "shown in the user's currency" — A: a per-user currency setting; B: EUR, the app's only currency (CLAUDE.md); settle: say EUR
